posts.headline: The Nasdaq just erased its entire 2026 gain in one brutal week — and the S&P 500 and Dow have fallen into a correction.
posts.caption:
Wall Street just gave back a year of gains in days — and if you have a 401(k), an RRSP or an index fund, it's your money too.

The Nasdaq fell 5.3% on Thursday and is now negative for 2026 — its entire gain for the year, gone. The S&P 500 and the Dow have both dropped into a correction, down at least 10% from their highs (CNBC, Nov. 19-20). The trigger: fears the AI boom is overbuilt, with an SEC accounting probe into Nvidia piling on. Canada didn't dodge it either — the TSX fell into a correction too (CBC).

My take: a correction isn't a crash, and selling into one is how a paper dip becomes a real loss — the hardest move is usually to do nothing.

Does a drop like this change what you do with your next paycheck's savings?

#StockMarket #Investing #401k #AI
